subject: Deep-dive scheduling: Tri-region architecture session
messages:
From: Alice Harper <alice.harper@netrix.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deep-dive: inference-serving architecture — scheduling

Hi Naomi / Monica,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. Netrix is ready to move to a 90-minute technical deep-dive next week — we want the Solutions Engineer + our platform architects (NA, EU, APAC) present. The primary constraints we have:

- EU team prefers afternoon CET/CEST;
- NA architects are flexible but prefer mornings (PT/ET);
- APAC architects (India and SG) can only do evenings local time due to support rotations (after 21:30 IST / 22:00 SGT).

We know DST differences are a pain — the goal is to lock a single 90-minute slot that hits everyone. Can you propose 2–3 options that map into each region? I can try to align internal schedules quickly once we have options.

Attaching a short requirements list (high level).

Thanks,
Alice Harper
Principal Cloud Architect | Netrix Systems
Alice.Harper@netrix.com
Attachment: netrix_requirements.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
To: Alice Harper <alice.harper@netrix.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-04-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive: inference-serving architecture — scheduling

Hi Alice — great framing, thanks.

We ran a quick availability scan for our SE + the internal folks and sketched a compact matrix (attached) that converts proposed windows across zones and accounts for DST offsets. Shortlist below (all 90-minute sessions):

Option A (US-morning / EU-afternoon / APAC-late-evening)
- Start: 09:30 PT / 12:30 ET / 17:30 BST / 21:00 IST / 22:00 SGT
- Duration: 90 minutes

Option B (US-early-morning / EU-late-afternoon / APAC-night)
- Start: 07:00 PT / 10:00 ET / 15:00 BST / 18:30 IST / 19:30 SGT
- Duration: 90 minutes

Option C (Split-run: 45m core + 45m hands-on) — we prefer a single slot but offer this as fallback if APAC attendance is strict.

Notes:
- Option A shifts slightly later for APAC and keeps EU in their comfort zone (late afternoon).
- Option B pulls EU earlier and APAC later in the evening; may be tough for on-call engineers.
- Option C reduces contiguous timezone overlap but allows hands-on lab for APAC after the EU sync.

I attached slot_matrix.csv with the same times expressed in PT/ET/BST/IST/SGT and a quick roundup of what each attendee should bring (access, list of example queries, sample trace).

If you can indicate which of these is tolerable for your architects (A/B/C) and any hard blocks, I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and the final attendee list.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.example
Attachment: slot_matrix.csv (csv, 8KB)

From: Rajiv Gupta <rajiv.gupta@netrix.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
Cc: Alice Harper <alice.harper@netrix.com>, netrix-it@netrix.com
Date: 2026-04-29T07:50:00+05:30
Subject: Re: Deep-dive: inference-serving architecture — scheduling

Hi Naomi — thanks for the options. Quick note from our APAC side: the India architect (me) and Singapore schedule are constrained — anything starting earlier than 21:00 IST is difficult on weekdays. Option A looks closest but the 21:00 IST start works better than Option B for us.

Two small asks:
- Can we shift the 90 minutes 15 minutes later (start 21:15 IST / 22:15 SGT) to account for a live handover from EMEA support?
- If the session will include a noisy load test or recording of PII, please flag so our security team can be looped.

Thanks — will confirm with the EU architects but marginal preference for Option A + 15m shift.

Rajiv
Senior Platform Architect | Netrix Systems
rajiv.gupta@netrix.com

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>
To: Rajiv Gupta <rajiv.gupta@netrix.com>, Alice Harper <alice.harper@netrix.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive: inference-serving architecture — scheduling

Thanks Rajiv — that 15-minute cushion is reasonable. A couple of operational points from our side:

- We can accommodate a 21:15 IST / 22:15 SGT start (Option A +15m) provided the EU group confirms the later end time. That would be: 09:45 PT / 12:45 ET / 17:45 BST start.
- We recommend keeping the session single 90-minute block for continuity. If APAC needs hands-on components after the EU wrap, we can schedule a 30m optional lab immediately after for APAC-only attendees (no SE required).
- For security: if you plan any traffic capture or sharing of traces with PII, please send redacted samples ahead of time and mark the agenda. We'll bring a minimal tracing artifact and anonymized example queries.

I'll tentatively hold 09:45 PT on our calendars once you confirm EU availability.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.example

From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
To: Alice Harper <alice.harper@netrix.com>, Rajiv Gupta <rajiv.gupta@netrix.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-04-30T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive: inference-serving architecture — scheduling

Thanks all — finalizing based on responses. EU architects confirmed they can extend to 18:30 BST that day, so we’ll lock Option A with the 15-minute cushion. Final scheduled slot below: 

FINAL: 90-minute deep-dive (Option A + 15m)
- Start: 09:45 PT / 12:45 ET / 17:45 BST / 21:15 IST / 22:15 SGT
- Duration: 90 minutes
- Date: 2026-05-06 (please confirm if this date works for Netrix — defaulting to the upcoming Thursday)

I attached the calendar invite (redwood_deepdive_invite.ics) and the joint prep doc (netrix_handshake_plan.pdf). Please reply-all to confirm exact attendees (names + emails) for the invite and any security redactions.

Pre-req checklist (short):
- Sample queries and one anonymized trace uploaded to the sheet above;
- Temporary read-only access to a staging bucket or example logs (if you want live tracing);
- List of attendees with role/area (infra, platform, SRE).

If Netrix confirms, I’ll send the invite and a zoom link with dial-ins for APAC.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.example
Attachments: redwood_deepdive_invite.ics (calendar invite), netrix_handshake_plan.pdf (pdf, 160KB)
